C07 and C16 use closely related Defense/Treasury machinery, but C22 is closest in both subject matter and administrative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The authority vested in the President ... to prescribe regulations authorizing occasions upon which the uniform may be worn ... is hereby delegated to the Secretary of Defense so far as it pertains to the uniforms of the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps, and to the Secretary of the Treasury so far as it pertains to the uniform of the Coast Guard.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense in respect of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps ... and the Secretary of the Treasury in respect of the Coast Guard ... are hereby authorized and directed ... to perform the functions vested in the President ... relative to prescribing the quantity and kind of clothing","explanation":"The child reuses the parent’s distinctive service-by-service allocation of a Presidentially vested clothing or uniform authority: Defense receives authority for the four principal military services, while Treasury receives the Coast Guard portion."}]}
